item.text: {"claim_count":41,"content_failure_reasons":["A3 reverses the source's stated relationship: Block 4 says the 397 billion pesos of lower IEPS collection were included within the stated 632 billion pesos of additional federal revenue; the normalized map instead calls the 397 billion an offset to that 632 billion. The source may be internally unclear, but the offset interpretation is not established by the extract.","E3's added conclusion that the difference between 2.4 million occupied persons and 753,000 IMSS positions represents an approximately 1.65 million informal or gap category is unsupported. The two measures need not share an identical population, timing, or accounting basis, and the extract expressly says most of the 2.4 million positions were formal.","The A5 verification note incorrectly says the extract qualifies the tax-revenue level as only the highest since 2016. Block 4 calls the 13.6% level the highest on record; 'since 2016' qualifies the 7.8% growth rate.","The C2 reopener compares an implied 2.9%-of-GDP interest amount with a supposed 4.4% average debt rate, but no 4.4% average rate appears in the extract; 4.4% is the RFSP-to-GDP figure. Although explicitly presented as a reopener and therefore excluded from claim_count, this is a substantive misreading.","Several scope and accounting qualifications are speculative rather than extract-grounded, including central-government-only coverage, likely exclusion of PEMEX/CFE spending, and revenues likely being gross of refunds or credits."],"content_usable":false,"material_omission":true,"material_omission_explanation":"The normalized map omits the extract's explicit statement that the 2.4 million jobs were 'en su mayoría formales' and replaces it with an unsupported informal-gap interpretation. That distortion is material to Chapter 5B economic-performance and information-reliability evidence. It also fails to preserve the extract's exact A5 distinction: the tax-revenue level was highest on record, while only the growth rate was highest since 2016.","schema_version":"reader_content_audit_v1","source_id":"GOV-003","supported_claim_count":39,"unsupported_claim_count":2,"usable_locator_count":41}
